create_dpo_trainer: create a DPOTrainer instance for Direct Preference Optimization training with a pretrained model and preference dataset
build_preference_data_collator: build a DataCollatorForPreference that pads chosen and rejected sequences into batched tensors with completion masks
build_vision_preference_collator: build a DataCollatorForVisionPreference that tokenizes and processes multimodal images with text for vision-language preference training
compute_dpo_loss: compute DPO loss using multiple loss types including sigmoid, hinge, ipo, aot, apo_zero, and discopop with reference model log probabilities
precompute_reference_logps: precompute reference model log probabilities for chosen and rejected responses and cache them for efficient DPO training
